_about: Fight bouts for SimBA's FightBack classifier (the sheet's 'Fight' tab; ToDo tab calls it FightBack): make_targets_inserted.py --labels fight_sheet_bouts.json --scorer HP --behavior FightBack --holdout 778 784 787. Training uses HP (Hannah), decided 2026-11-17; VH is kept for comparison. HP has no 791, so move Trial 791.csv out of targets_inserted while training FightBack. Built 2026-11-17. Same convention as attack_sheet_bouts.json: onset/offset copied as-is from the sources and read as inclusive 0-based frames, 30 fps. Empty list = scored, no fights. Trial missing = not scored. VH = Viviana, from the qt-vid-score CSVs (776 = ver2; 784 = 'Track 1784_attack_timestamps.csv'; 782 = project saved with no bouts). HP = Hannah, from the 'Fight' tab of 'Manual Video scoring - SDS'. Each HP block's last row (blank onset, offset = last frame of the video, Frames = SUM of the bouts) is a totals row, not a bout, and is left out; 0-0 rows mean no fights (782, 786). Not scored for Fight: HP 791; VH 786; both 793 onward.
